admission.justification: Realized across models/concepts.py, validate/concepts.py, validate/jargon.py and cli/validate.py and proved by unit, CLI and compiler tests; prevents silent first-slug-wins jargon matcher shadowing and gate/matcher normalization drift.

applicability: Concept variant generation, cross-card collision validation and jargon matcher construction across models/concepts.py, validate/concepts.py, validate/jargon.py and cli/validate.py.
conditions: concept_variants deduplicates normalized (' '.join(raw.lower().split())) terms, aliases and simple -s/-es plurals within one card so same-card duplicate aliases never trigger a cross-card collision.

_validate_term_collisions emits deterministic concept-term-collision findings across distinct slugs in sorted order, _build_term_matcher raises ValueError on collision rather than shadowing via setdefault, and cli/validate.py::_run_memory_checks short-circuits jargon matching after concept-term-collision findings.
exclusions: Irregular English plurals beyond simple -s/-es suffixes are outside automatic variant expansion and must be listed explicitly as aliases.
statement: Normalized concept terms, aliases, and generated -s/-es plurals must be computed by one shared concept_variants helper and fail closed without silent shadowing whenever two distinct Concept Cards collide.
title: Shared concept_variants normalization and fail-closed collision gate
